title: Concept: Reusable workflow inherits every secret in yaml — review required
description: In yaml, a job calls a reusable workflow with secrets: inherit. Every secret visible to the caller becomes visible to the callee, so the callee’s permissions are the union of everything the repository holds. A change in that workflow, or a mistake in its steps, exposes credentials that had nothing to do with the job.
applicability: yaml workflows that call reusable workflows.
risk: Over-broad credential exposure through a callee; MEDIUM severity.
